idea-plugin.name: CodeRef
idea-plugin.description:
This plugin copies a file reference with line and column numbers to the clipboard for selected text or cursor position. Compatible with IntelliJ IDEA and WebStorm.
Features: - Copies file path with line and column numbers for selections (e.g., "src/main/MyFile.java:4:10-10:25") - Copies cursor position when no selection (e.g., "src/main/MyFile.java:4:10") - Works with any file type - Uses relative paths from project root - Simple and lightweight - Supports both IntelliJ IDEA and WebStorm
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Version 1.2.0: - Added column numbers to copied references (e.g., "file.kt:10:5-20:15") - Now copies cursor position when no text is selected (e.g., "file.kt:10:5") - Improved precision for code location references
Version 1.1.0: - Added WebStorm compatibility (WS-252.25557.126+) - Updated to support IntelliJ IDEA 2024.3+ - Updated to Java 17 and Kotlin 1.9.25
Version 1.0.0: - Initial release - Copy file reference with line numbers to clipboard

action.description: Copies file reference with line numbers to clipboard
